process_area.title: IBP Financial Integration, Performance & Continuous Improvement

value_stream.name: Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) & Integrated Business Planning

fields.Participants: S&OP Lead, Finance/FP&A (links to VS-17.4), Merchandising (links to VS-101), Treasury (links to VS-18), Strategy (links to VS-33), Supply (links to VS-02), Commodity (links to VS-106)
fields.Volume: Financial reconciliation across the plan horizon

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-reconcile of "reconciled to the corporate budget" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-file of "S&OP/Finance quantify plan-vs-budget gaps" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "record and the IBP steering" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: monthly financial reconciliation; operational: decision costing
Pain Points / Risks: - **Volume-finance-disconnect risk**: Volume plan looks good but misses financial targets; mitigated by monthly financial reconciliation
- **Hidden-cost risk**: Plan decisions carry uncosted expedites/builds/markdowns; mitigated by decision costing
System Touchpoints: - FP&A (links to VS-17.4); merchandise financial plan (links to VS-101); pricing (links to VS-01.2); commodity (links to VS-106); FX (links to VS-18.3); treasury (links to VS-18); strategy (links to VS-33)

steps.activity: S&OP/Finance translate the constrained volume plan (links to W3920) into financial terms: revenue (× price links to VS-01.2), COGS (× cost incl. commodity/FX links to VS-106/VS-18.3), gross margin (links to VS-101), and inventory investment, reconciled to the corporate budget (links to VS-33/VS-17.4)

S&OP/Finance quantify plan-vs-budget gaps (revenue/margin/inventory/EBITDA links to profile §9.4), identify financial risk (markdown need links to VS-101, commodity exposure links to VS-106, FX links to VS-18.3), and feed gap-closing to exec S&OP (links to W3912/W3919)
S&OP/Finance document the financial implications of plan decisions (e.g., expedite cost, inventory build cost, markdown cost) for the decision record and the IBP steering

fields.Participants: S&OP Lead, Merchandising/Merch Planners (links to VS-01/VS-101), Finance (links to VS-17.4), Buyers (links to VS-01/VS-03), Supply (links to VS-02), Insights (links to VS-28.1)
fields.Trigger: S&OP plan (W3920); MFP/OTB cycle (links to VS-101)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-flag of "flag OTB pressure requiring markdown re-plan or receipt re-phasing" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-file of "S&OP/Merchandising feed the seasonal MFP refresh" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-612 (ensure controlled execution — IBP Financial Integration, Performance & Continuous Improvement (PA-127.3).)
- operational: OTB tracking and re-phasing; operational: alignment
Pain Points / Risks: - **OTB-breach risk**: Volume plan consumes OTB faster than planned; mitigated by OTB tracking and re-phasing
- **Markdown-mismatch risk**: S&OP plan and MFP markdown budget diverge; mitigated by alignment
System Touchpoints: - MFP/OTB (links to VS-101); assortment (links to VS-01); procurement (links to VS-03/VS-122); finance (links to VS-17.4); analytics (links to VS-28.1)

steps.activity: S&OP/Merchandising align the S&OP volume plan to the merchandise financial plan and OTB (links to VS-101): sales plan, receipt plan, markdown budget, IMU/maintained margin, and turn/GMROI/WOS targets, reconciling volume→pesos
S&OP/Merchandising manage OTB consumption against the plan (commitments vs open-to-buy links to VS-101), and flag OTB pressure requiring markdown re-plan or receipt re-phasing
S&OP/Merchandising feed the seasonal MFP refresh (links to VS-101/profile §13.2) and align buyer purchase decisions (links to VS-01/VS-03/VS-122) to the constrained plan

fields.Participants: S&OP Lead, Supply Chain Strategy, Logistics (links to VS-06/VS-110), DC (links to VS-04), Real Estate/Network (links to VS-20/VS-97), Sourcing (links to VS-122), Finance (links to VS-40/VS-105), Strategy (links to VS-33)
fields.Trigger: Strategic cycle; constraint patterns from S&OP

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-file of "S&OP/Supply-Chain-Strategy feed recurring S&OP constraints into network/design decisions" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-track of "track design-decision impact on S&OP KPIs" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-612 (ensure controlled execution — IBP Financial Integration, Performance & Continuous Improvement (PA-127.3).)
- operational: quarterly design input; operational: Finance partnership (links to VS-40)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Short-termism risk**: S&OP focuses on the month, missing structural network fixes; mitigated by quarterly design input
- **Capex-blind risk**: Design ideas without capex/ROI discipline; mitigated by Finance partnership (links to VS-40)
System Touchpoints: - Network design (links to VS-20/VS-04/VS-06); real estate (links to VS-20/VS-97); sourcing (links to VS-122); capex (links to VS-40/VS-112); strategy (links to VS-33)

steps.activity: S&OP/Supply-Chain-Strategy feed recurring S&OP constraints into network/design decisions: DC capacity expansion (links to VS-04/VS-20), new DC for growth regions (links to profile §3.2/VS-20), import-flow consolidation (links to VS-122/VS-110), vendor-base restructuring (links to VS-03/VS-122), and inventory-pooling/cross-dock (links to VS-04)

S&OP/Real-Estate/Finance evaluate network-capex options (new DC, store growth links to VS-37/VS-20, transport fleet links to VS-06/VS-110) with ROI and capacity scenarios (links to VS-40/VS-112), informed by S&OP demand/supply scenarios (links to W3917)
S&OP feed insights into corporate strategy (links to VS-33) and the multi-year plan, and track design-decision impact on S&OP KPIs (service, turn, cost)

fields.Participants: S&OP Lead, Finance/FP&A (links to VS-17.4), Treasury (links to VS-18), SCF (links to VS-105), Supply (links to VS-02), Sourcing (links to VS-122/VS-105), Merchandising (links to VS-101)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "S&OP/Treasury/SCF align financing for the inventory plan" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-flag of "flag working-capital pressure to exec S&OP" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-612 (ensure controlled execution — IBP Financial Integration, Performance & Continuous Improvement (PA-127.3).)
- operational: CCC/financing alignment; operational: explicit trade-off analysis
Pain Points / Risks: - **Working-capital-strain risk**: Plan builds inventory beyond cash capacity; mitigated by CCC/financing alignment
- **Service-vs-capital trade-off risk**: Cutting inventory to save cash hurts service; mitigated by explicit trade-off analysis
System Touchpoints: - FP&A (links to VS-17.4); treasury (links to VS-18); SCF (links to VS-105); procurement (links to VS-03/VS-15); import (links to VS-122); inventory (links to VS-05/VS-101)

steps.activity: S&OP/Finance project the inventory-investment requirement from the plan (purchase commitments, in-transit, on-hand by category/season), and the resulting cash-conversion-cycle and working-capital need

S&OP/Treasury/SCF align financing for the inventory plan: supplier terms (links to VS-03/VS-15), SCF/reverse-factoring/dynamic-discounting (links to VS-105), import LC/TT (links to VS-18/VS-122), and seasonal pre-build financing
S&OP/Finance optimize the inventory investment vs service/turn trade-off (links to W3914), and flag working-capital pressure to exec S&OP (links to W3919) for plan adjustment

fields.Participants: S&OP Lead, Insights (links to VS-28.1), Demand Planning, Supply (links to VS-02), Finance (links to VS-17.4), Merchandising (links to VS-01), Store Ops (links to VS-07), Logistics (links to VS-06/VS-110)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-file of "S&OP/Insights maintain the S&OP scorecard" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-report of "S&OP/Insights produce the monthly S&OP performance report" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-reconcile of "reconcile to corporate KPIs" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: a tight, decision-relevant scorecard; operational: bias metric (links to W3911)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Metric-overload risk**: Too many KPIs dilute focus; mitigated by a tight, decision-relevant scorecard
- **Blind-to-bias risk**: Accuracy reported without bias hides systematic error; mitigated by bias metric (links to W3911)
System Touchpoints: - BI/analytics (links to VS-28.1); forecast accuracy (links to W3911); finance (links to VS-101/VS-17.4); corporate KPIs (links to VS-33)

steps.activity: S&OP/Insights maintain the S&OP scorecard: forecast accuracy/bias (links to W3911), plan adherence (links to W3920), service level (fill-rate/on-time replenishment links to profile §12.3), inventory turn/WOS (links to W3914), cycle participation/discipline, and decision follow-up closure
S&OP/Insights produce the monthly S&OP performance report (plan vs actual, KPI trend, exceptions), and present at exec S&OP (links to W3919) and to the IBP steering
S&OP/Finance roll up financial performance (revenue/margin/inventory vs plan links to VS-101/VS-17.4) and reconcile to corporate KPIs (links to VS-33)

fields.Participants: S&OP Lead, Demand Planning, Supply (links to VS-02), Merchandising (links to VS-01), Insights (links to VS-28.1), Store Ops (links to VS-07), Logistics (links to VS-06/VS-110), Finance (links to VS-17.4)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-categorize of "S&OP/Demand analyze plan-vs-actual variance" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-assign of "assign corrective action" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track corrective-action closure" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-612 (ensure controlled execution — IBP Financial Integration, Performance & Continuous Improvement (PA-127.3).)
- operational: no-fault root-cause framing; operational: closed-loop feedback
Pain Points / Risks: - **Blame-culture risk**: Variance review becomes blame-shifting; mitigated by no-fault root-cause framing
- **Learning-loss risk**: Variances not fed back to improve the plan; mitigated by closed-loop feedback
System Touchpoints: - Analytics (links to VS-28.1); sales/actuals (links to VS-08/VS-28); supply (links to VS-02); promo (links to VS-58); typhoon (links to VS-69); forecast (links to W3911)

steps.activity: S&OP/Demand analyze plan-vs-actual variance (demand/supply/inventory/financial), categorize (forecast error, supply miss, execution gap, external event), and quantify impact

S&OP/Functions run root-cause on material variances (model gap links to W3911, supply disruption links to W3915, promo over/under links to W3909, store execution links to VS-07, typhoon/disruption links to VS-69), and assign corrective action
S&OP feed learnings into the next cycle (model tuning links to W3911, plan adjustments links to W3920, policy changes), and track corrective-action closure

fields.Participants: S&OP Lead, IT (links to VS-27/VS-113), Data Engineering (links to VS-28), Data Science (links to VS-30.2), Enterprise Architecture (links to VS-113), Master Data (links to VS-29), Finance (links to VS-17.4)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-forecast of "S&OP/IT maintain the S&OP/IBP platform" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-issue of "issues that distort the plan" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-log of "S&OP/Data Science maintain and retrain forecasting models, run champion/challenger" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-612 (ensure controlled execution — IBP Financial Integration, Performance & Continuous Improvement (PA-127.3).)
- operational: data-quality controls (links to VS-29); operational: EA-informed selection (links to VS-113)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Data-quality risk**: Bad masters/history distort the forecast; mitigated by data-quality controls (links to VS-29)
- **Tooling-rigidity risk**: Platform can't model BuildRight's complexity; mitigated by EA-informed selection (links to VS-113)
System Touchpoints: - S&OP platform; data warehouse (links to VS-28); ML (links to VS-30.2); EA (links to VS-113); master data (links to VS-29); IT ops (links to VS-27)

steps.activity: S&OP/IT maintain the S&OP/IBP platform: demand/supply/inventory data integration (links to VS-28/VS-113), forecasting engine (links to VS-30.2), scenario tooling, plan publication, and KPI dashboards (links to VS-28.1)

S&OP/Master-Data ensure data quality for planning (item/location/customer masters links to VS-29, sales history integrity, lead-time accuracy, safety-stock parameters), and fix data issues that distort the plan (links to VS-27 W734)
S&OP/Data Science maintain and retrain forecasting models, run champion/challenger, and upgrade tooling/platform on the technology cycle (links to VS-113/VS-27.1 W495)

fields.Participants: S&OP Lead, COO, Functions (links to VS-01/VS-02/VS-14/VS-17.4/VS-06/VS-122), Strategy (links to VS-33), Insights (links to VS-28.1), Internal Audit (links to VS-21), Innovation (links to VS-30)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-file of "S&OP Lead/COO run the annual S&OP maturity assessment" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-forecast of "S&OP Lead develop the maturity-improvement roadmap" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track maturity progression, and report to the executive committee" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-612 (ensure controlled execution — IBP Financial Integration, Performance & Continuous Improvement (PA-127.3).)
- operational: annual assessment and exec sponsorship; operational: balanced roadmap
Pain Points / Risks: - **Stalled-maturity risk**: Process stays at basic maturity without progression; mitigated by annual assessment and exec sponsorship
- **Tooling-over-people risk**: Investing in tooling without process/talent change; mitigated by balanced roadmap
System Touchpoints: - Maturity model/scorecard; analytics (links to VS-28.1); strategy (links to VS-33); talent (links to VS-19.4); innovation (links to VS-30); audit (links to VS-21)

steps.activity: S&OP Lead/COO run the annual S&OP maturity assessment (process, people, data, tooling, governance — vs a maturity model), benchmark accuracy/service/turn vs profile targets (§12.3) and retail benchmarks, and identify gaps

S&OP Lead develop the maturity-improvement roadmap (process discipline, forecast capability links to W3911, IBP financial integration links to W3921, tooling upgrade links to W3927, talent links to VS-19.4), and prioritize with exec sponsorship
S&OP Lead execute quarterly improvement actions, track maturity progression, and report to the executive committee (links to VS-33/VS-36)
